metadata.services: Double Play Bundle: Fiber 500 + Digital TV ($95/mo)

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is David. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi David. I'm trying to sort out my accounts. I have my internet with you, and also my mobile phone, but they're on two separate bills and have two separate logins. I'd like to combine them if possible.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely, we can definitely help with that. Merging accounts is a great way to simplify your billing. To get started, I'll need to pull up your primary account. Do you have your customer ID for the internet service handy?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I do. It's CUST-1006.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Margaret. And for security purposes, can you please verify the 4-digit security PIN associated with this account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, sure. It should be 8963.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that's a match. Thank you for verifying. I have your Double Play Bundle account pulled up here. Now, how can I best find the mobile account? The phone number for it would be great.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, the number is 555-821-1234.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, 555-821-1234. Give me just one moment to locate that in our system.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Take your time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, I see it. A single mobile line under Margaret Harris as well. So, the process will be to migrate this mobile service onto your primary broadband account. It's fairly straightforward.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds perfect. That's exactly what I want.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Before I can initiate the account merge, my system requires that all accounts involved are in good standing. I am seeing a flag here on the broadband account, CUST-1006, indicating a past-due balance.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Past due? That's not right. I'm on automatic debit, it should have been paid.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can understand the confusion. Let me check the payment history for you... Yes, I see here that an automatic payment was attempted on the 5th of the month, but it was declined by the bank.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Declined? Why would it be declined?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Often this happens if the credit card on file has expired, or if there was a temporary issue with the card issuer. The outstanding balance is for one billing cycle, a total of $95.00.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, for heaven's sake. You know what, I think I did get a new card from my bank last month. I must have forgotten to update it. I'm sorry about that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No problem at all, it's a very common thing. We can take care of that payment right now over the phone if you'd like, and then I can proceed with merging the accounts for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, let's do that. I have the new card right here.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Whenever you're ready.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It's a Visa. The number is 4277... 1109... 8845... 6001.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And the expiration date?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the three-digit security code from the back?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That is 391.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. So I am submitting a one-time payment of $95.00 on your Visa ending in 6001. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please hold one moment while this processes...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, thank you for waiting. The payment has been approved. Your confirmation number is 75B-1A9-3C4. The account is now current.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wonderful. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Would you like me to update this new card as your default for automatic payments going forward?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, yes please. That would save me another call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. I am updating the auto-pay information now... and... done. It's all set. Your next bill will be debited from this new card.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. So, can we merge the accounts now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, we can. I have all the authorization I need. What I'm going to do is make your broadband account the 'master' account, and then migrate your mobile service line to be a part of it.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The process on my end will take about three to four minutes to complete. It involves releasing the mobile line from its old account structure and re-provisioning it under the new one. Is it alright if I place you on a brief hold while I complete this?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's fine. I'll wait.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience. I'll be back with you shortly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Margaret. I appreciate your patience.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem. Did it work?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, it did. I'm happy to report that the account merge was successful. Your mobile line, 555-821-1234, is now officially part of your CUST-1006 account. You'll receive a single, unified bill from now on.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, that's fantastic news! So much simpler.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It is. Just as a heads-up, your first unified bill might look a little unusual. It will likely contain some pro-rated charges for the mobile service to align its billing date with your broadband's billing cycle. But after that, it will be a single, predictable monthly amount.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That makes sense. I understand. As long as it's all on one bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Now, we have one final, very important step. Since we've created a new unified account structure, we also need to create a new, single security PIN for it. Your old PIN of 8963 is no longer active.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, okay. So I need to set a new one?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's correct. This will be the master PIN for your entire Cymbal Telecom account. You can choose any 4-digit number that's easy for you to remember but hard for others to guess.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay... let me think for a second...

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright, I have one. Let's make it 2407.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, 2407. And just to confirm, can you repeat that for me one more time?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, two-four-zero-seven.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I'm updating your account file now with the new master PIN. Please make a note of it for your records, as you will need it anytime you call us for support.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I've written it down. 2407.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The update is complete. Your new PIN is now active in our system.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you so much. You've been very helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure, Margaret. So, just to recap our call: we successfully processed a payment to bring your account current, updated your card on file for auto-pay, merged your mobile and broadband accounts under a single customer ID, and set a new master security PIN for the unified account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That covers everything. You got it all done.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Was there anything else at all I could assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was it. That was the big one on my to-do list.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm glad I could help you cross it off. Well then, thank you for being a loyal Cymbal Telecom customer.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, David.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. Have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Bye bye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
